Model Number: A120F
Anker Laptop Charger Pro
The Smart Laptop Charger Built to Protect Your Battery
 
Protect Your Laptop Battery
The charger recognizes your laptop model, and Care Mode applies a laptop-specific charging curve for long-term battery care and up to 40% longer battery lifespan.
 
100W Max Fast Charging
Delivers up to 100W of fast charging with sustained full-power output at an ambient temperature of 77°F (25°C).
 
Visualize Every Charge
See real-time power, temperature, and charging progress through interactive visuals and playful animations.
 
Unlock More with Anker Charging Manager
Install the Anker Charging Manager app to set custom wallpapers, access free software updates, and adjust the MacBook charging threshold from 80% to 100% for long-term battery care.
 
Small. Light. Travel-Ready.
38% smaller and 33% lighter than the original 96W charger, with a 90° foldable plug for effortless travel.
 

Notes:

1. This is a wall charger, not a power bank.
2. OTA updates, custom wallpapers, and charging threshold control require the Anker Charging Manager app to be installed on your laptop.
3. The charger recognizes compatible devices and automatically applies a device-specific charging curve. It recognizes MacBook Pro, MacBook Air (M2 - M5), MacBook Neo, iPhone 15 - 17 series, and iPad models, including iPad Pro, iPad Air, and iPad mini. Support for the iPhone 18 Pro series is available through OTA updates. With Anker Charging Manager installed, it can also recognize select Windows laptops, including ThinkPad X1 and Dell XPS models.
4. Charging from 0% to 50% in 30 minutes was tested using a 14" MacBook Pro (M5, 2025). Sustained 100W output without power reduction was tested at an ambient temperature of 77°F (25°C). Data is based on Anker internal lab testing; actual performance may vary.
5. The up-to-40% battery lifespan extension is based on internal bare-cell lab testing. Actual laptop battery lifespan extension may vary significantly depending on device configuration and usage.
6. In Care Mode, the laptop's internal battery temperature stays up to 9°F (5°C) lower and the charger surface temperature is up to 18°F (10°C) lower compared with the original 96W charger. Data is based on Anker internal lab testing during a full charge from 0% to 100% at an ambient temperature of 77°F (25°C), with Care Mode enabled throughout.
7. When a custom wallpaper is set, the screen stays on. Press and hold for 2 seconds to turn it off.
8. When the charger is connected to a hub's PD charging port, it can charge normally but cannot connect to the app. When connected to a data port, it can connect to the app but cannot charge normally.

FAQ

How does the Laptop Charger Pro recognize my laptop?

It identifies your specific laptop model instantly upon connection. Mac recognition is 100%, while Windows achieves over 90% accuracy when using the desktop app. This enables tailored charging: the charger reads the connected device and adjusts its output accordingly, ensuring safe and optimal power delivery for your exact model.

Does the Anker Laptop Charger Pro require a desktop app?

Yes, for Windows device recognition. The desktop app is essential for full model identification and unlocking Care Mode features on Windows laptops. Mac users get basic recognition without it, but the app provides the complete charging dashboard—battery health, cycle count, temperature, and health score—for both platforms.

What is Care Mode on the Laptop Charger Pro?

Care Mode uses your laptop's model to apply a tailored charging curve. When you connect your laptop, the charger identifies the model and matches the charging behavior to that device rather than applying one universal curve. It also works with the adjustable 80%–100% charging limit to support battery health management. Anker says this approach can extend battery lifespan by up to 40%. Learn more about this battery-focused charging experience in Anker's smarter desk charging setup.

Can this Laptop Charger Pro extend my laptop battery life?

Yes, it is designed to help extend battery lifespan by reducing unnecessary time at a full charge. The software and charger work together to support an 80% charging limit, while the PC app lets you switch between two practical modes:
  • Care Mode: keeps charging capped at 80% for long-term plugged-in use.
  • Travel Mode: allows the laptop to charge fully when you need maximum battery capacity.
This battery-management approach can extend battery lifespan by up to 40%, helping balance everyday charging needs with long-term battery care. For a closer look at the product, read the Anker Laptop Charger Pro Review.

Is the Laptop Charger Pro compatible with MacBook?

Yes, with 100% Mac model recognition. Different MacBooks have varying charging requirements, but this charger identifies your specific MacBook model and automatically matches the optimal charging curve. It delivers tailored power for each MacBook, ensuring efficient and safe charging without overloading or underpowering.

How fast can the Laptop Charger Pro charge a laptop?

It delivers 100W max and charges a 14" MacBook Pro to 100% in 55 minutes. GaN technology ensures 100W sustained output without derating at 25°C, permanently. This truly replaces your original adapter, providing consistent full-speed charging without throttling, even during extended use.

What does the Smart Display show on the Laptop Charger Pro?

The Smart Display shows charging power, temperature, and charging mode in real time. You can see power changing dynamically, such as 65W, 80W, and 100W, instead of treating charging as a black box. The charger also includes a safety chip that monitors temperature 120 times per second. When paired with the PC charging dashboard, you can see additional information such as charging status, battery health, temperature, cycle count, capacity, and health score for a more detailed view of your laptop’s charging state.

Can the Laptop Charger Pro charge multiple devices at once?

No. The Laptop Charger Pro has one USB-C port, so it can charge only one device at a time. Its advantage is high-power, single-device charging, with up to 100W output for compatible laptops. It supports PD 3.1, PPS, and AVS protocols, making it compatible with a broad range of USB-C devices, including laptops, tablets, phones, earbuds, and drones. If you need to charge several devices simultaneously, a multi-port charger is a better fit for that use case, while this model prioritizes focused laptop charging.
